pitch: The %s pays well for things with no serial numbers
note: IP-neutral. The market's back-of-the-stall side: a stall that buys contraband at twice its value and asks no questions. It buys anything else you carry too ('*' in 'buys') at 'any_rate' of its value, the gear trader's rate, so nothing bought in town sells here at a profit. The legal goods (gun and jetpack upgrades, the sniper rifle, jetpacks) are the gear trader's. 'resells': false = what it buys is not sold on (it pays more than it would ask). Smuggling: pick it up outside the gate, get it past the checkpoint, sell it here. Issue #64: 'bounties' = it also pays out Oda's bounties on Remnant officers ([E] once the target is dead). Issues #208, #209: 'offers' it sells from a menu: after the first bounty is paid, his signature quantonium armour (src/systems/items/gear_upgrades.gd). 'endless': an offer he never runs out of (the armour: once unlocked, buy it, sell it back to him, buy it again). 'locked': an offer whose 'requires' do not hold yet still shows on the menu, greyed, with this hint for when it opens.
